restorePending.title: A restore is waiting to be applied
restorePending.body: Restart the POS now. Anything recorded before the restart will be replaced by the backup.

automatic.title: Automatic backups
automatic.description: A copy is saved on this PC every 6 hours and the last 7 days are kept. With an activated license each copy is also uploaded to the cloud.
automatic.noBackupYet: No backup yet. Click Back up now.
automatic.cloudNeedsLicense: Available with an activated license. Backups on this PC and to USB still work.
automatic.cloudOffline: No internet. Your data is safe on this PC and will upload when the internet is back.
automatic.cloudUnreachable: Cloud can't be reached right now

restore.title: Restore
restore.description: Replace the data on this PC with an earlier backup. Your current data is saved on this PC first, so a restore can be undone.
restore.adminOnly: Only an admin can restore a backup. Ask your admin to sign in on this PC.
restore.undoDescription: Your data as it was before the last restore, saved {time} · {size}
restore.noLocalBackups: No backups on this PC yet.
restore.fileHelp: Pick a backup file saved with Save to USB / file. Use this to move your data to a new PC or when there is no internet.

confirm.title: Restore {label}?
confirm.beforeLastRestore: the data from before the last restore
confirm.replacesEverything: All data on this PC will be replaced. Sales recorded after this backup was made will no longer show.
confirm.canUndo: Your current data is kept first, so you can undo this with Undo last restore.
confirm.restartAndSignIn: The POS will restart and you will need to sign in again.
